name: GradientBlinds-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The full diagonal blind pattern and its bright spotlight are both clearly visible.

tagline: Diagonal stripes of pink, violet and blue glow like lit venetian blinds.
summary: A full-screen field of soft diagonal gradient stripes in pink, violet and blue, with a bright spotlight that follows the pointer and a fine film-grain noise over the top.
appearance: Parallel diagonal stripes on black, each a soft-edged band that fades from dark to bright, running pink through violet to cyan-blue across the group. A round white spotlight brightens one area, and a fine grain textures the surface.
behaviour: The spotlight glides toward the pointer with a little damping, brightening whichever stripes it covers. A gentle noise flickers over the surface, and the gradient can be angled, mirrored or distorted.
search_phrases: colorful blinds effect for a hero
gradient bars with a glow spot
use_when: You want a colourful, graphic backdrop that still reads as abstract light, for a hero or event page.
avoid_when: The bright stripes are high-contrast and busy, so text needs a scrim, and it never stops animating.
customise: Props set gradient colours, angle, noise, blind count and minimum width, mouse dampening, mirroring, spotlight radius, softness and opacity, distortion, shine direction and blend mode.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL shader with grain noise redraws on every frame.

a11y.note: The grain and spotlight animate forever and ignore reduced-motion; the canvas has no label.

issues: The bright high-contrast stripes fight any text placed directly over them.
It ignores reduced-motion, and the grain flickers continuously.
polish_why: Bold, clean gradient stripes with a smooth spotlight; busy enough to need a text scrim.
